method: Two probes 70 s apart (coreutils timeout 70): /proc/uptime, WSL `date +%s.%N`, then Windows [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow via powershell.exe interop
clocksource: tsc (available: tsc hyperv_clocksource_tsc_page hyperv_clocksource_msr acpi_pm); kernel 6.6.87.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2
reading: WSL wall time follows the Windows clock; the VM's monotonic clock runs about 10% slow and the wall clock is corrected in +3.58 s steps (wall-steps-100s.json). powershell.exe start-up latency (about 0.5 s) bounds the Windows reading's precision.
